name: Shadowgrange Archfiend
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, each opponent sacrifices a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control. You gain life equal to the greatest power among creatures sacrificed this way.
Madness—{2}{B}, Pay 8 life. (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
blocked_sentences: You gain life equal to the greatest power among creatures sacrificed this way

needs.what: a madness cost that is a full cost node (mana plus pay_life), so 'Madness—{2}{B}, Pay 8 life' charges 8 life alongside the mana when the madness cast is taken
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The card-level `madness` key is `str | None` in cards/schema.py and the loader parses it with ManaCost.parse, so it holds mana only; writing just {2}{B} would drop the 8-life payment and make the card strictly cheaper than printed. `alternative_cost` takes a cost node but is offered from hand, not from the madness exile window

needs.what: a value giving the GREATEST power among a list of snapshots (the per-player list `sacrifice` with `players` + `snapshot` writes), i.e. max rather than sum over last-known powers
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `power_of` over the list binding sums it (Reign of the Pit's 'total power'), which overcounts with two or more opponents; `extreme_value` resolves a selector pool by oid and reads current characteristics, which after the sacrifice are the graveyard card's printed power, not last-known; `max` takes a fixed list of expressions, not a binding list
